topic: 5 things you need to know: Nvidia's first earnings after its CEO's exit
post:
A week after its CEO stepped down, Nvidia just reported its quarter. 📈
Here are 5 things you need to know.

1️⃣ Revenue roughly doubled
Nvidia reported about $115.8 billion in quarterly revenue, roughly double a year earlier and ahead of the ~$109 billion analysts expected, per The Next Web.

2️⃣ Data centers are the whole story
The data center business brought in $107.6 billion, up 110% year over year. That's the AI infrastructure boom in one number. 🏗️

3️⃣ Margins stayed high
Gross margin came in at 74.8%.

4️⃣ The leadership question got an answer
Interim CEO Colette Kress said the board will not reinstate Jensen Huang.

5️⃣ The next chips are shipping
Nvidia said it has started shipping its Vera Rubin NVL72 platform, and raised its outlook. 🚀

Why it matters:
The AI boom didn't pause for a leadership crisis. Demand for AI computing is still growing fast, and that shapes the price and availability of every AI tool you use. ⚡

Practical takeaway:
Separate the headlines from the numbers. A big story about people doesn't always change the business underneath. 🔍

Does this change how you see the AI boom? 👇
